cards.text: Israel is camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho, ready to cross into Canaan. The LORD speaks again to Moses, Israel's leader, and this time it's about the Levites. They do the work of the Tent of Meeting, and they won't receive an inheritance among the Israelites (Numbers 18:23).

cards.question: The Levites won't get a territory of their own. So what does the LORD tell the other tribes to give them?

answers.text: Cities to live in with pasturelands
A strip of land by the Great Sea

cards.text: The pasturelands are for the Levites' herds, flocks and other livestock, and they're measured out in cubits from the city wall on every side. EXACT numbers in every direction, and I'm over here measuring chocolate chips by "until it feels right."
Now here's where it gets interesting. Six of those Levite cities get a special job.

cards.question: Six of the Levites' cities are to be cities of ___, where a manslayer may flee.

cards.text: Add forty-two more cities to those six, and that's forty-eight cities for the Levites, each with its pasturelands.

cards.question: True or false: Every tribe gives the Levites the same number of cities, no matter how big the tribe is.

cards.text: Then the LORD tells Moses that once Israel crosses the Jordan into Canaan, they're to set those cities of refuge apart. A city of refuge is a place to run to, so the question is, who's running?

cards.question: Who are the cities of refuge for?

answers.text: Someone who kills a person by accident
Someone who kills a person on purpose
Someone who kills an enemy in battle

cards.text: The cities are a refuge from the avenger, so the manslayer won't be killed before he has a trial.

cards.question: The city of refuge keeps the manslayer alive until he stands trial. Who does he stand trial before?

cards.text: Six cities of refuge in all. And two and a half tribes already have their land across the Jordan, toward the sunrise (Numbers 34:14-15).

cards.question: True or false: All six cities of refuge are in the land of Canaan.
True or false: The six cities of refuge are also open to a foreigner living among the Israelites.

cards.text: Then the LORD turns to a different case. If anyone strikes and kills a person with an iron object, a stone of deadly size, or a deadly object of wood, he is a murderer.

cards.question: If someone kills a person with an iron object, a deadly stone or a deadly piece of wood, what does the LORD say must happen to him?

answers.text: He must be put to death
He must pay the family back
He must be sent out of the land

cards.question: A murderer must surely be put to death. Who does the LORD say is to do it?

cards.text: It's not only about weapons, friend. If anyone maliciously pushes a person or intentionally throws something at him and the person dies, the one who did it is a murderer too.

cards.question: True or false: Striking someone with just a hand, in hostility, so that he dies, still makes a person a murderer.

cards.text: Now flip it around. If someone suddenly pushes a person without hostility, throws something without meaning to, or drops a heavy stone without looking, and the person dies, but the one who did it was no enemy and never meant any harm.
Then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood, by these ordinances.

cards.question: When a killing was an accident, what is the assembly to do with the manslayer?

answers.text: Protect him from the avenger of blood
Hand him over to the avenger of blood
Make him pay the family a fine

cards.text: Then the assembly sends the manslayer back to the city of refuge he fled to, and there he has to STAY. This is not a weekend getaway, friend.

cards.question: The manslayer must live in his city of refuge until the ___ of the high priest.

cards.text: But what if the manslayer goes outside the limits of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood finds him out there?

cards.question: True or false: If the avenger of blood kills the manslayer outside his city of refuge, the avenger is guilty of bloodshed.
True or false: Once the high priest dies, the manslayer may return to the land he owns.

cards.text: And these rules aren't just for the trip into Canaan. They're a statutory ordinance for the generations to come, wherever Israel lives.

cards.question: Before a murderer can be put to death, how many witnesses does it take?

cards.text: Now, could somebody just pay their way out of all this? Like offering the referee twenty bucks to take back a red card?

cards.question: What does the LORD say about taking a ransom for a murderer who deserves to die?

answers.text: Accept it if the family agrees
Accept it once a priest approves

cards.question: True or false: A manslayer in a city of refuge can pay a ransom to go home before the high priest dies.

cards.text: Then the LORD tells them not to pollute the land where they live, because bloodshed pollutes the land.

cards.question: No atonement can be made for land where blood is shed, except by the ___ of the one who shed it.
Why does the LORD tell Israel not to defile the land where they live?

answers.text: Their crops will not grow there
Other nations will hear of it
